+
+  # Redact inline
+  python /workspace/pii_anonymizer.py --mode redact input.json -o output.json
+
+  # Deterministic hashing with a salt
+  python /workspace/pii_anonymizer.py --mode hash --salt "my_salt" input.json --in-place
+
+  # JSON Lines
+  python /workspace/pii_anonymizer.py --jsonl input.jsonl > output.jsonl
+
+Notes
+- Name detection is based on field names only to avoid false positives in free text.
+- Email/phone/SSN are detected anywhere inside string values (inline substitutions).

+PHONE_RE = re.compile(
+    r"(?:(?<!\d)(?:\+?\d{1,3}[\s.-]?)?(?:\(\d{3}\)|\d{3})[\s.-]?\d{3}[\s.-]?\d{4}(?:\s*(?:x|ext\.?|extension)\s*\d{1,6})?(?!\d))"
+)
+SSN_RE = re.compile(r"(?<!\d)(\d{3})[- ]?(\d{2})[- ]?(\d{4})(?!\d)")
+
+# Keys that imply the value is a person's name. Lowercased comparison.
+NAME_KEYS = {
+    "name",
+    "full_name",
+    "first_name",
+    "last_name",
+    "middle_name",
+    "given_name",
+    "surname",
+    "applicant_name",
+    "contact_name",
+    "legal_name",
+}
+

+@dataclass
+class AnonymizerConfig:
+    mode: str = "tokenize"  # redact | tokenize | hash
+    salt: str | None = None
+    enabled_types: set[str] = field(default_factory=lambda: {"name", "email", "phone", "ssn"})
+
+
+class Anonymizer:
+    def __init__(self, cfg: AnonymizerConfig):
+        self.cfg = cfg
+        self._token_counters: Dict[str, int] = {"name": 0, "email": 0, "phone": 0, "ssn": 0}
+        self._token_map: Dict[tuple[str, str], str] = {}
+
+    def _hash(self, pii_type: str, value: str) -> str:
+        salt = self.cfg.salt or ""
+        h = hashlib.sha256((pii_type + "\0" + salt + "\0" + value).encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
+        return f"{pii_type.upper()}_H:{h[:16]}"
+
+    def _token(self, pii_type: str, value: str) -> str:
+        key = (pii_type, value)
+        if key in self._token_map:
+            return self._token_map[key]
+        self._token_counters[pii_type] += 1
+        tok = f"{pii_type.upper()}_{self._token_counters[pii_type]}"
+        self._token_map[key] = tok
+        return tok
+
+    def _redact(self, pii_type: str, value: str) -> str:
+        return f"[REDACTED:{pii_type.upper()}]"
+
+    def _replace_value(self, pii_type: str, value: str) -> str:
+        if self.cfg.mode == "redact":
+            return self._redact(pii_type, value)
+        if self.cfg.mode == "hash":

+        return self._token(pii_type, value)

+        # Replace email/phone/ssn inline in any string

+            return self._replace_value("email", m.group(0)) if "email" in self.cfg.enabled_types else m.group(0)
+
+        def repl_phone(m: re.Match[str]) -> str:
+            return self._replace_value("phone", m.group(0)) if "phone" in self.cfg.enabled_types else m.group(0)
+
+        def repl_ssn(m: re.Match[str]) -> str:
+            full = m.group(0)
+            return self._replace_value("ssn", full) if "ssn" in self.cfg.enabled_types else full
+
+        s = EMAIL_RE.sub(repl_email, s)
+        s = PHONE_RE.sub(repl_phone, s)
+        s = SSN_RE.sub(repl_ssn, s)
+        return s

+    def anonymize(self, data: Any, key_path: list[str] | None = None) -> Any:
+        if key_path is None:
+            key_path = []
+
+        if isinstance(data, Mapping):
+            out: Dict[str, Any] = {}
+            for k, v in data.items():

+                if last_key in NAME_KEYS and "name" in self.cfg.enabled_types:

+    if jsonl:
+        for line in fp:

+            if not line:
+                continue

+    else:
+        yield json.load(fp)
+
+
+def dump_json_stream(items: Iterable[Any], fp: io.TextIOBase, jsonl: bool) -> None:
+    first = True
+    for item in items:
+        if jsonl:
+            fp.write(json.dumps(item, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")
+        else:

+        first = False
+
+

+    p = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="PII anonymizer/redactor for JSON")
+    p.add_argument("input", nargs="?", help="Input JSON file path (or omit for stdin)")
+    p.add_argument("-o", "--output", help="Output file path (default: stdout)")
+    p.add_argument("--in-place", action="store_true", dest="in_place", help="Write result back to input file")
+    p.add_argument("--jsonl", action="store_true", help="Treat input as JSON Lines (NDJSON)")
+    p.add_argument("--mode", choices=["redact", "tokenize", "hash"], default="tokenize")
+    p.add_argument("--salt", help="Salt for hash mode (recommended)")
+    p.add_argument(
+        "--types",

+    )
+    return p.parse_args(argv)
+
+
+def main(argv: Sequence[str] | None = None) -> int:
+    ns = parse_args(sys.argv[1:] if argv is None else argv)
+
+    if ns.in_place and (not ns.input or ns.output):
+        print("--in-place requires a single input file and cannot be used with --output", file=sys.stderr)
+        return 2
+
+    enabled_types = {"name", "email", "phone", "ssn"}
+    if ns.types:
+        parts = {p.strip().lower() for p in ns.types.split(",") if p.strip()}
+        invalid = parts - enabled_types
+        if invalid:
+            print(f"Unknown types: {sorted(invalid)}", file=sys.stderr)
+            return 2
+        enabled_types = parts
+
+    cfg = AnonymizerConfig(mode=ns.mode, salt=ns.salt, enabled_types=enabled_types)
+    anonymizer = Anonymizer(cfg)
+
+    input_stream: io.TextIOBase
+    close_in = False
+    if ns.input and ns.input != "-":
+        input_stream = open(ns.input, "r", encoding="utf-8")
+        close_in = True
+    else:
+        input_stream = sys.stdin
+
+    outputs: List[Any] = []
+    try:

+            outputs.append(anonymizer.anonymize(item))
+    finally:

+            dump_json_stream(outputs, f, ns.jsonl)
+    else:

+        close_out = False
+        if ns.output and ns.output != "-":

+        else:

+                fp.close()

+"""

+Features
+- Detects and anonymizes: names (by key/column), emails, phone numbers, SSNs
+- Modes:
+  - redact: replaces with tags like [REDACTED:EMAIL]
+  - tokenize: stable tokens within a run (EMAIL_1, NAME_2, ...)
+  - hash: salted SHA-256 (shortened), deterministic across runs given the same salt
+- JSON: nested objects, arrays, and JSON Lines (NDJSON) with --jsonl
+- CSV: header-based name column detection + inline scanning for other PII
+
+Usage examples
+  # JSON, tokenize (default)
+  python /workspace/pii_anonymizer.py input.json > output.json
+
+  # JSON redact inline
+  python /workspace/pii_anonymizer.py --mode redact input.json -o output.json
+
+  # JSON hash with salt
+  python /workspace/pii_anonymizer.py --mode hash --salt "my_salt" input.json --in-place
+
+  # JSON Lines
+  python /workspace/pii_anonymizer.py --jsonl input.jsonl > output.jsonl
+
+  # CSV tokenize
+  python /workspace/pii_anonymizer.py --csv input.csv > output.csv
+
+  # CSV redact with explicit delimiter
+  python /workspace/pii_anonymizer.py --csv --mode redact --csv-delimiter ';' input.csv -o output.csv
+

+    "name",
+    "full_name",
+    "first_name",
+    "last_name",
+    "middle_name",
+    "given_name",
+    "surname",
+    "applicant_name",
+    "contact_name",
+    "legal_name",

+class AnonymizerConfig:
+    mode: str = "tokenize"  # redact | tokenize | hash

+"""
+PII anonymizer/redactor for JSON and CSV.
+
+Features
+- Detects and anonymizes: names (by key/column), emails, phone numbers, SSNs
+- Modes:
+  - redact: replaces with tags like [REDACTED:EMAIL]
+  - tokenize: stable tokens within a run (EMAIL_1, NAME_2, ...)
+  - hash: salted SHA-256 (shortened), deterministic across runs given the same salt
+- JSON: nested objects, arrays, and JSON Lines (NDJSON) with --jsonl
+- CSV: header-based name column detection + inline scanning for other PII
+
+Usage examples
+  # JSON, tokenize (default)
+  python /workspace/pii_anonymizer.py input.json > output.json
+
+  # JSON redact inline
+  python /workspace/pii_anonymizer.py --mode redact input.json -o output.json
+
+  # JSON hash with salt
+  python /workspace/pii_anonymizer.py --mode hash --salt "my_salt" input.json --in-place
+
+  # JSON Lines
+  python /workspace/pii_anonymizer.py --jsonl input.jsonl > output.jsonl
+
+  # CSV tokenize
+  python /workspace/pii_anonymizer.py --csv input.csv > output.csv
+
+  # CSV redact with explicit delimiter
+  python /workspace/pii_anonymizer.py --csv --mode redact --csv-delimiter ';' input.csv -o output.csv
+
+Notes
+- Name detection is based on field/column names only to avoid false positives in free text.
+- Email/phone/SSN are detected anywhere inside string values (inline substitutions).

+import argparse
+import hashlib
+import io
+import json
+import re
+import sys
+import csv

+from typing import Any, Dict, Iterable, List, Mapping, Sequence
+

+EMAIL_RE = re.compile(r"[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\.[A-Za-z]{2,}")
+PHONE_RE = re.compile(
+    r"(?:(?<!\d)(?:\+?\d{1,3}[\s.-]?)?(?:\(\d{3}\)|\d{3})[\s.-]?\d{3}[\s.-]?\d{4}(?:\s*(?:x|ext\.?|extension)\s*\d{1,6})?(?!\d))"
+)
+SSN_RE = re.compile(r"(?<!\d)(\d{3})[- ]?(\d{2})[- ]?(\d{4})(?!\d)")
+
+# Keys that imply the value is a person's name. Lowercased comparison.
+NAME_KEYS = {
+    "name",
+    "full_name",
+    "first_name",
+    "last_name",
+    "middle_name",
+    "given_name",
+    "surname",
+    "applicant_name",
+    "contact_name",
+    "legal_name",
+}
+
+
+@dataclass
+class AnonymizerConfig:
+    mode: str = "tokenize"  # redact | tokenize | hash
+    salt: str | None = None
+    enabled_types: set[str] = field(default_factory=lambda: {"name", "email", "phone", "ssn"})
+
+
+class Anonymizer:
+    def __init__(self, cfg: AnonymizerConfig):
+        self.cfg = cfg
+        self._token_counters: Dict[str, int] = {"name": 0, "email": 0, "phone": 0, "ssn": 0}
+        self._token_map: Dict[tuple[str, str], str] = {}
+
+    def _hash(self, pii_type: str, value: str) -> str:
+        salt = self.cfg.salt or ""
+        h = hashlib.sha256((pii_type + "\0" + salt + "\0" + value).encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
+        return f"{pii_type.upper()}_H:{h[:16]}"
+
+    def _token(self, pii_type: str, value: str) -> str:
+        key = (pii_type, value)
+        if key in self._token_map:
+            return self._token_map[key]

+        tok = f"{pii_type.upper()}_{self._token_counters[pii_type]}"
+        self._token_map[key] = tok
+        return tok
+
+    def _redact(self, pii_type: str, value: str) -> str:
+        return f"[REDACTED:{pii_type.upper()}]"
+
+    def _replace_value(self, pii_type: str, value: str) -> str:
+        if self.cfg.mode == "redact":
+            return self._redact(pii_type, value)
+        if self.cfg.mode == "hash":
+            return self._hash(pii_type, value)
+        return self._token(pii_type, value)

+    def _replace_inline(self, s: str) -> str:
+        # Replace email/phone/ssn inline in any string
+        def repl_email(m: re.Match[str]) -> str:

+

+            return self._replace_value("phone", m.group(0)) if "phone" in self.cfg.enabled_types else m.group(0)
+

+            return self._replace_value("ssn", full) if "ssn" in self.cfg.enabled_types else full
+
+        s = EMAIL_RE.sub(repl_email, s)
+        s = PHONE_RE.sub(repl_phone, s)
+        s = SSN_RE.sub(repl_ssn, s)
+        return s
+
+    def anonymize(self, data: Any, key_path: list[str] | None = None) -> Any:
+        if key_path is None:
+            key_path = []
+
+        if isinstance(data, Mapping):
+            out: Dict[str, Any] = {}
+            for k, v in data.items():
+                k_str = str(k)
+                out[k_str] = self.anonymize(v, key_path + [k_str])
+            return out
+        if isinstance(data, list):
+            return [self.anonymize(v, key_path) for v in data]
+        if isinstance(data, str):
+            # If the key name indicates a person's name, replace the whole value.
+            if key_path:
+                last_key = key_path[-1].lower()
+                if last_key in NAME_KEYS and "name" in self.cfg.enabled_types:
+                    return self._replace_value("name", data)
+            # Otherwise, perform inline substitutions for other PII.
+            return self._replace_inline(data)
+        return data
+
+
+def load_json_stream(fp: io.TextIOBase, jsonl: bool) -> Iterable[Any]:
+    if jsonl:
+        for line in fp:
+            line = line.strip()
+            if not line:
+                continue
+            yield json.loads(line)
+    else:
+        yield json.load(fp)
+
+
+def dump_json_stream(items: Iterable[Any], fp: io.TextIOBase, jsonl: bool) -> None:
+    first = True
+    for item in items:
+        if jsonl:
+            fp.write(json.dumps(item, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")
+        else:
+            if not first:
+                # If multiple items are provided for non-JSONL, keep last
+                pass
+            out = json.dumps(item, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)

+
+
+def header_is_name(col: str) -> bool:
+    c = col.strip().lower()
+    if c in NAME_KEYS:
+        return True
+    # Heuristic: contains the word "name"
+    return bool(re.search(r"\bname\b", c))
+
+
+def process_csv_text(text: str, anonymizer: Anonymizer, delimiter: str | None = None, quotechar: str | None = None, has_header: bool = True) -> str:
+    if delimiter is None or quotechar is None:
+        try:
+            sniffer = csv.Sniffer()
+            sample = "\n".join(text.splitlines()[:10])
+            dialect = sniffer.sniff(sample) if sample else csv.get_dialect("excel")
+        except Exception:
+            dialect = csv.get_dialect("excel")
+        if delimiter is None:
+            delimiter = getattr(dialect, "delimiter", ",")
+        if quotechar is None:
+            quotechar = getattr(dialect, "quotechar", '"')
+

+
+    out_buf = io.StringIO()

+    headers: List[str] | None = None

+

+

+
+
+def parse_args(argv: Sequence[str]) -> argparse.Namespace:
+    p = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="PII anonymizer/redactor for JSON and CSV")
+    p.add_argument("input", nargs="?", help="Input file path (or omit for stdin)")
+    p.add_argument("-o", "--output", help="Output file path (default: stdout)")
+    p.add_argument("--in-place", action="store_true", dest="in_place", help="Write result back to input file")
+
+    # Input mode options

+    p.add_argument("--csv-quotechar", dest="csv_quote", help="CSV quotechar override (default: sniff or '\"')")

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""
+PII anonymizer/redactor for JSON and CSV.
+
+Features
+- Detects and anonymizes: names (by key/column), emails, phone numbers, SSNs
+- Modes:
+  - redact: replaces with tags like [REDACTED:EMAIL]
+  - tokenize: stable tokens within a run (EMAIL_1, NAME_2, ...)
+  - hash: salted SHA-256 (shortened), deterministic across runs given the same salt
+- JSON: nested objects, arrays, and JSON Lines (NDJSON) with --jsonl
+- CSV: header-based name column detection + inline scanning for other PII
+
+Usage examples
+  # JSON, tokenize (default)
+  python /workspace/pii_anonymizer.py input.json > output.json
+
+  # JSON redact inline
+  python /workspace/pii_anonymizer.py --mode redact input.json -o output.json
+
+  # JSON hash with salt
+  python /workspace/pii_anonymizer.py --mode hash --salt "my_salt" input.json --in-place
+
+  # JSON Lines
+  python /workspace/pii_anonymizer.py --jsonl input.jsonl > output.jsonl
+
+  # CSV tokenize
+  python /workspace/pii_anonymizer.py --csv input.csv > output.csv
+
+  # CSV redact with explicit delimiter
+  python /workspace/pii_anonymizer.py --csv --mode redact --csv-delimiter ';' input.csv -o output.csv
+
+Notes
+- Name detection is based on field/column names only to avoid false positives in free text.
+- Email/phone/SSN are detected anywhere inside string values (inline substitutions).
+"""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+import hashlib
+import io
+import json
+import re
+import sys
+import csv
+from dataclasses import dataclass, field
+from typing import Any, Dict, Iterable, List, Mapping, Sequence
+
+
+EMAIL_RE = re.compile(r"[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\.[A-Za-z]{2,}")
+PHONE_RE = re.compile(
+    r"(?:(?<!\d)(?:\+?\d{1,3}[\s.-]?)?(?:\(\d{3}\)|\d{3})[\s.-]?\d{3}[\s.-]?\d{4}(?:\s*(?:x|ext\.?|extension)\s*\d{1,6})?(?!\d))"
+)
+SSN_RE = re.compile(r"(?<!\d)(\d{3})[- ]?(\d{2})[- ]?(\d{4})(?!\d)")
+
+# Keys that imply the value is a person's name. Lowercased comparison.
+NAME_KEYS = {
+    "name",
+    "full_name",
+    "first_name",
+    "last_name",
+    "middle_name",
+    "given_name",
+    "surname",
+    "applicant_name",
+    "contact_name",
+    "legal_name",
+}
+
+
+@dataclass
+class AnonymizerConfig:
+    mode: str = "tokenize"  # redact | tokenize | hash
+    salt: str | None = None
+    enabled_types: set[str] = field(default_factory=lambda: {"name", "email", "phone", "ssn"})
+
+
+class Anonymizer:
+    def __init__(self, cfg: AnonymizerConfig):
+        self.cfg = cfg
+        self._token_counters: Dict[str, int] = {"name": 0, "email": 0, "phone": 0, "ssn": 0}
+        self._token_map: Dict[tuple[str, str], str] = {}
+
+    def _hash(self, pii_type: str, value: str) -> str:
+        salt = self.cfg.salt or ""
+        h = hashlib.sha256((pii_type + "\0" + salt + "\0" + value).encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
+        return f"{pii_type.upper()}_H:{h[:16]}"
+
+    def _token(self, pii_type: str, value: str) -> str:
+        key = (pii_type, value)
+        if key in self._token_map:
+            return self._token_map[key]
+        self._token_counters[pii_type] += 1
+        tok = f"{pii_type.upper()}_{self._token_counters[pii_type]}"
+        self._token_map[key] = tok
+        return tok
+
+    def _redact(self, pii_type: str, value: str) -> str:
+        return f"[REDACTED:{pii_type.upper()}]"
+
+    def _replace_value(self, pii_type: str, value: str) -> str:
+        if self.cfg.mode == "redact":
+            return self._redact(pii_type, value)
+        if self.cfg.mode == "hash":
+            return self._hash(pii_type, value)
+        return self._token(pii_type, value)
+
+    def _replace_inline(self, s: str) -> str:
+        # Replace email/phone/ssn inline in any string
+        def repl_email(m: re.Match[str]) -> str:
+            return self._replace_value("email", m.group(0)) if "email" in self.cfg.enabled_types else m.group(0)
+
+        def repl_phone(m: re.Match[str]) -> str:
+            return self._replace_value("phone", m.group(0)) if "phone" in self.cfg.enabled_types else m.group(0)
+
+        def repl_ssn(m: re.Match[str]) -> str:
+            full = m.group(0)
+            return self._replace_value("ssn", full) if "ssn" in self.cfg.enabled_types else full
+
+        s = EMAIL_RE.sub(repl_email, s)
+        s = PHONE_RE.sub(repl_phone, s)
+        s = SSN_RE.sub(repl_ssn, s)
+        return s
+
+    def anonymize(self, data: Any, key_path: list[str] | None = None) -> Any:
+        if key_path is None:
+            key_path = []
+
+        if isinstance(data, Mapping):
+            out: Dict[str, Any] = {}
+            for k, v in data.items():
+                k_str = str(k)
+                out[k_str] = self.anonymize(v, key_path + [k_str])
+            return out
+        if isinstance(data, list):
+            return [self.anonymize(v, key_path) for v in data]
+        if isinstance(data, str):
+            # If the key name indicates a person's name, replace the whole value.
+            if key_path:
+                last_key = key_path[-1].lower()
+                if last_key in NAME_KEYS and "name" in self.cfg.enabled_types:
+                    return self._replace_value("name", data)
+            # Otherwise, perform inline substitutions for other PII.
+            return self._replace_inline(data)
+        return data
+
+
+def load_json_stream(fp: io.TextIOBase, jsonl: bool) -> Iterable[Any]:
+    if jsonl:
+        for line in fp:
+            line = line.strip()
+            if not line:
+                continue
+            yield json.loads(line)
+    else:
+        yield json.load(fp)
+
+
+def dump_json_stream(items: Iterable[Any], fp: io.TextIOBase, jsonl: bool) -> None:
+    first = True
+    for item in items:
+        if jsonl:
+            fp.write(json.dumps(item, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")
+        else:
+            if not first:
+                # If multiple items are provided for non-JSONL, keep last
+                pass
+            out = json.dumps(item, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
+            fp.write(out)
+        first = False
+
+
+def header_is_name(col: str) -> bool:
+    c = col.strip().lower()
+    if c in NAME_KEYS:
+        return True
+    # Heuristic: contains the word "name"
+    return bool(re.search(r"\bname\b", c))
+
+
+def process_csv_text(text: str, anonymizer: Anonymizer, delimiter: str | None = None, quotechar: str | None = None, has_header: bool = True) -> str:
+    if delimiter is None or quotechar is None:
+        try:
+            sniffer = csv.Sniffer()
+            sample = "\n".join(text.splitlines()[:10])
+            dialect = sniffer.sniff(sample) if sample else csv.get_dialect("excel")
+        except Exception:
+            dialect = csv.get_dialect("excel")
+        if delimiter is None:
+            delimiter = getattr(dialect, "delimiter", ",")
+        if quotechar is None:
+            quotechar = getattr(dialect, "quotechar", '"')
+
+    src = io.StringIO(text)
+    reader = csv.reader(src, delimiter=delimiter, quotechar=quotechar)
+
+    out_buf = io.StringIO()
+    writer = csv.writer(out_buf, delimiter=delimiter, quotechar=quotechar, lineterminator="\n")
+
+    headers: List[str] | None = None
+    name_cols: set[int] = set()
+
+    for i, row in enumerate(reader):
+        if i == 0 and has_header:
+            headers = row
+            name_cols = {idx for idx, h in enumerate(headers) if header_is_name(h)}
+            writer.writerow(headers)
+            continue
+        new_row: List[str] = []
+        for idx, cell in enumerate(row):
+            cell_str = cell if isinstance(cell, str) else str(cell)
+            if idx in name_cols and "name" in anonymizer.cfg.enabled_types:
+                new_row.append(anonymizer._replace_value("name", cell_str))
+            else:
+                new_row.append(anonymizer._replace_inline(cell_str))
+        writer.writerow(new_row)
+
+    return out_buf.getvalue()
+
+
+def parse_args(argv: Sequence[str]) -> argparse.Namespace:
+    p = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="PII anonymizer/redactor for JSON and CSV")
+    p.add_argument("input", nargs="?", help="Input file path (or omit for stdin)")
+    p.add_argument("-o", "--output", help="Output file path (default: stdout)")
+    p.add_argument("--in-place", action="store_true", dest="in_place", help="Write result back to input file")
+
+    # Input mode options
+    p.add_argument("--jsonl", action="store_true", help="Treat input as JSON Lines (NDJSON)")
+    p.add_argument("--csv", action="store_true", help="Treat input as CSV with a header row")
+    p.add_argument("--csv-delimiter", dest="csv_delim", help="CSV delimiter override (default: sniff or ',')")
+    p.add_argument("--csv-quotechar", dest="csv_quote", help="CSV quotechar override (default: sniff or '\"')")
+
+    # Transform options
+    p.add_argument("--mode", choices=["redact", "tokenize", "hash"], default="tokenize")
+    p.add_argument("--salt", help="Salt for hash mode (recommended)")
+    p.add_argument("--types", help="Comma-separated types to process (name,email,phone,ssn). Default: all")
+    return p.parse_args(argv)
+

+  # JSON redact inline

+
+  # JSON hash with salt
+  python /workspace/pii_anonymizer.py --mode hash --salt "my_salt" input.json --in-place
+
+  # JSON Lines
+  python /workspace/pii_anonymizer.py --jsonl input.jsonl > output.jsonl

+  # CSV tokenize

+  # CSV redact with explicit delimiter

+import argparse

+    "last_name",
+    "middle_name",
+    "given_name",
+    "surname",
